caption_plain: Shows the shapes the explorer found in the data and the part each dimension plays.

shapes.label_plain: time series: 44 quarter (row and col summed)

not_applicable.map: the data has no polygons (ring_x and ring_y)
not_applicable.network: no variable links a dimension to itself (X, X_)
not_applicable.tree: no variable gives the parent of each node
not_applicable.circular: no variable is an angle or a time of day
not_applicable.points: no two variables give x and y positions
not_applicable.profiles: no variable lies along a non-time axis
not_applicable.groups: the data has no dimension with groups to compare
not_applicable.correlation: a correlation needs at least two numeric variables
not_applicable.vif: collinearity needs at least two drivers
